name: Gen Con
blurb: The largest tabletop-gaming convention in North America, with thousands of board, card and roleplaying game events at the Indiana Convention Center.

editions.evidence: Homepage countdown/footer text: "Gen Con Returns August 5 - 8, 2027" / "COUNTDOWN TO GEN CON August 5 - August 8, 2027 Indianapolis, IN"

notes: gencon.com itself has no general celebrity-guest page (/guests 404s); Gen Con is primarily an exhibitor/event-driven tabletop convention. It does host an affiliated Gen Con Writers' Symposium (genconwriters.org) each year with dozens of sci-fi/fantasy author panelists, but that program lives on a separate site and its 2027 lineup is not posted yet, so guests is set to 'unavailable' rather than fabricating a list.
